admin.agent.description: Let agents operate this admin panel through Skills or MCP.

admin.agent.skill_hint: Copy this prompt to your agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw…), then send it the key you issued under Agents. The agent saves each project's URL and key in a private local credentials file (readable only by you), never in a repository. For several ShipAny projects, copy the prompt from this page on each site. Note: the key stays in the chat history — revoke it under Agents if it leaks or is no longer needed.
admin.agent.skill_prompt:
Please add "{app}" ({url}) as a ShipAny project you can manage, under the project name "{name}".

1. If you don't have the shipany-admin skill yet, download these two files into a shipany-admin folder in your skills directory (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/shipany-admin/). If it's already installed, skip this step and don't overwrite it: the client can read every project's key, so update it only when I explicitly ask, from a site I trust.
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=SKILL.md → shipany-admin/SKILL.md
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=admin-client.mjs → shipany-admin/scripts/admin-client.mjs
2. I'll send you this project's admin key (starts with sa_admin_) next. Save it via stdin — never as a command argument — and never repeat it afterwards:
   printf '%s' '<key>' | node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs add {name} {url}
3. Run node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs --project {name} list and tell me which operations you can call.
4. From then on, follow SKILL.md strictly for the admin tasks I give you; when managing several projects, name the project with --project on every call.
admin.agent.full_docs: Full reference (idempotency, audit, local stdio MCP bridge, CLI agent/key management): docs/admin-agent.md in the repository.
admin.agent.never_warning: A non-expiring key works until you revoke it. Give the agent minimal roles, and revoke the key as soon as it's no longer needed or may have leaked.
admin.agent.created_warning: Copy this key now — it won't be shown again. Store it in the agent's secret store, never in the repository.
admin.agent.revoke_warning: Revoke this key? Agents using it lose access immediately. This can't be undone.
admin.agent.accounts_hint: Each agent is an API-type user: its permissions are the RBAC roles you assign, and it signs in only with its admin API keys. Agents aren't counted as users.
admin.agent.agent_form_hint: Pick the roles this agent acts with. You can only grant roles whose permissions you hold yourself.

admin.agent.keys_hint: Admin API keys (sa_admin_…) for this agent. Only a hash is stored; a key is shown once. They never work on the product API.
admin.agent.delete_warning: The agent account, its role assignments and all its keys are removed. Agents using them lose access immediately. Its execution history is kept.

landing.hero.headline: The headless engine for your next SaaS.
landing.hero.subheadline: Auth, payments, subscriptions, credits, RBAC, CMS, and i18n — all pre-wired. Just build your product on top.
landing.features.title: Everything you need to ship
landing.features.description: Pre-wired business logic so you can focus on building your product.
landing.features.auth.title: Authentication
landing.features.auth.description: Email/password, Google, and GitHub OAuth — ready out of the box with session management and account linking.
landing.features.payment.title: Payments
landing.features.payment.description: Stripe, PayPal, Alipay, WeChat Pay — checkout, subscriptions, webhooks, and order management.
landing.features.rbac.title: Roles & Permissions
landing.features.rbac.description: Fine-grained RBAC with wildcard matching. Full admin panel for managing users, roles, and permissions.
landing.features.i18n.title: Internationalization
landing.features.i18n.description: English and Chinese built-in with locale-aware routing. Easy to extend with additional languages.
landing.features.cms.title: Content Management
landing.features.cms.description: Categories and posts with full CRUD, status management, and admin panel — build your blog or docs.
landing.features.credits.title: Credit System
landing.features.credits.description: FIFO consumption, expiration, auto-grant on signup, and revocation — ready for usage-based billing.
landing.pricing.title: Pricing
landing.pricing.description: Choose the plan that works for you.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.description: Everything you need to know before getting started.
landing.faq.stack.question: What's the tech stack?
landing.faq.stack.answer: Next.js 16 with the App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Drizzle ORM, and better-auth. Every piece of business logic is inlined — no external packages for payment, email, storage, or AI.
landing.faq.payment.question: Which payment providers are supported?
landing.faq.payment.answer: Stripe, PayPal, Creem, Alipay, and WeChat Pay out of the box. The PaymentManager abstraction makes it straightforward to add more providers by implementing a single interface.
landing.faq.database.question: Which databases can I use?
landing.faq.database.answer: Drizzle ORM handles PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Turso, and Cloudflare D1. Switch providers by editing DATABASE_PROVIDER in your .env — the schema templates and drizzle config adapt automatically.
landing.faq.customize.question: How customizable is the landing page?
landing.faq.customize.answer: The src/blocks/ directory ships with demo sections — they're designed to be rewritten per project. The durable primitives live in src/components/, so your rebrand touches blocks and translations, not the chassis.
landing.faq.license.question: Can I use this for commercial projects?
landing.faq.license.answer: Yes. ShipAny TanStack is built for shipping production SaaS products. You own the code after cloning — no per-seat fees, no runtime dependencies on our infrastructure.
landing.cta.headline: Ready to ship your SaaS?
landing.cta.subheadline: Stop wiring auth, payments, and RBAC from scratch. Start with ShipAny TanStack and build what actually makes your product unique.

dash.import.prompt_instruction: Research this product website: {url}. Open its homepage, pricing page, about page and official social accounts, and fill in the JSON below using only public, verifiable information. Leave a field as an empty string when you cannot find it; never make anything up. Images and videos must be absolute URLs that open directly. Reply with one JSON code block only. Write generated copy (shortDesc, longDesc, tagline, slogan, categories, tags, link names, metaData) in English by default; keep the product name, URLs, emails and addresses as the site shows them. Field meanings:
dash.import.json_placeholder: Paste the JSON returned by Codex or ChatGPT here
dash.import.json_help: You can paste the whole reply; the JSON is extracted automatically. Malformed URLs and emails are ignored.
